title: 60th Anniversary Fly-In
description: 60 years on the Front Range and we're just getting started. Join us for our 60th Anniversary Fly-In at Platte Valley Airpark (18V) in Fort Lupton, CO. Everyone is welcome — fly in or drive up. CAP breakfast starts with coffee and pastries at 7:30 AM, followed by the pancake breakfast from 8–10 AM (donations welcome). Blessed BBQ on the ramp serving at 10 AM. Vintage Aero Flying Museum open all day (vafm.org). Cooling station with misters, bubbles, and squirt guns for the kids. 7507 CR 39, Fort Lupton, CO 80621 | CTAF 122.9

title: Coffee & Donuts
description: The classic 18V tradition. Show up, grab a coffee, swap a story on the ramp. No agenda. Just community. Free and open to all.

title: Pancake Breakfast: Great Turnout!
description: Over 100 people showed up for our first Pancake Breakfast Fly-In of 2026. Thank you to everyone who flew in or drove out. Stay tuned for the next one.

title: Pancake Fly-In: Thanks for Coming Out!
description: Another great morning on the ramp at 18V. Fresh pancakes and the Vintage Aero Flying Museum. Thank you to everyone who flew in or drove out to join us.
